repairs.quote: When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for 6 seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants (70/110/150/190/230 + (50% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds. When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds.
